bootstrap.execution: stdlib bootstrap only; copies pinned bytes into new staging and runs none of them

carrier_authority: Use the exact independently approved local/delivery archive SHA. A later reviewed carrier may have a different outer hash only when supplied by its real release receipt; these three helper hashes must still match. The bootstrap cannot authenticate who authorized an archive.
protected: No raw three-helper bodies or base64 relay
No client runtime replacement or v7 updater repurposing
No helper, engine, account, schedule or plugin registration from bootstrap
SIM provenance and actual local execution permission remain separate from live entitlement
publisher_requirement: Deliver the complete approved Core/helper carrier to a location the selected device can actually access alongside the selected kit, using the real supported file/download path. Bind outer SHA, three member hashes, helper revision and local entrypoints in the delivery receipt. Cloud plugin installation alone does not establish device-local files.
